Unsan building footprint layer source and usage
===============================================

This prototype uses Korea Building Footprints v2 from Esri Korea Living Atlas
as an online feature layer. It does not bundle an offline building-footprint
export in this directory.

Source
------

Item title: 전국 건물 도형 v2 / Korea Building Footprints v2
ArcGIS item: https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=b2c7a37bac8d4e40a85435b3f3d96d05
Feature layer: https://portal.esrikr.com/arcgis/rest/services/MOIS_KR_Buildings_v2/FeatureServer/0
Raw data source: Korean Ministry of Interior and Safety, 주소기반산업지원서비스
Raw source link: https://business.juso.go.kr/jst/jstAddressCuration
Release version: 2026.1
Data reference date: 2026.07
Service updated: 2026.08
Spatial reference: KGD2002 Unified Coordinate System / EPSG:5179

Metadata checked on 2026-10-01 at the item and layer URLs above.

Use in this prototype
---------------------

The app queries the online FeatureServer from the browser. The flow is:

1. Query all object IDs for Unsan-myeon (sig_cd 44210, emd_cd 380).
2. Fetch features in chunks by returned IDs.
3. Verify every returned object ID and polygon geometry before drawing.
4. Keep the returned features in browser memory for visualization only.
5. Do not write or redistribute an offline building export.

Known count checks
------------------

- Full Unsan-myeon filter: sig_cd='44210' AND emd_cd='380' => 4,970 records.
- Original prototype bbox against this source => 872 records.
- Previous Overture extract for the same bbox => 4 records, so Overture is no
  longer used as the building source for this prototype.

Usage terms from the item metadata
----------------------------------

The item metadata states that rights are reserved by the Korean Ministry of
Interior and Safety. It also states that the layer is intended to support online
visualization and analysis, and that users are not permitted to export data for
offline use outside of Korea.

This note applies that restriction narrowly and directly: the prototype uses
online visualization and analysis, and it does not create an offline export for
redistribution or use outside Korea. This note does not add broader restrictions
beyond the source item's stated terms, and it does not grant rights beyond those
terms.

Display limitations
-------------------

The source layer supplies polygon footprints and attributes such as building
name, road name, lot number, building type code, and ground-floor count. It does
not supply actual building heights. Ground-floor count is shown only as a source
attribute. Footprints are rendered flat over the 3D terrain.

Completeness limitations
------------------------

The app can verify that it received all records returned by the source query, but
that does not prove that every real building in the field is present or current
in the source. New construction, demolition, address-data lag, or source omissions
may remain.
